target_description.entry_point: Witness construction from arbitrary trace data
target_description.input_format: Arbitrary bytes interpreted as trace entries (intermediate states, input sequences, auxiliary computation data)
assertions: Must not panic on any input — malformed trace data is rejected gracefully
Constructed witness has consistent internal structure if accepted
target_description.critical_finding_criteria: Panic on any input, or witness construction accepting inconsistent trace data

campaign_methodology.seed_corpus_source: Test witnesses from existing property and unit test suites

campaign_results.notes: 60-second fuzzing campaign executed successfully. 2.5M executions at 41.7k exec/s with no crashes or panics. All malformed trace data was rejected gracefully. No inconsistent witness construction detected. Corpus stabilized at 147 entries.
